Job details mentioned below:
 Job Title: UI/UX Developer
 Location: McLean VA 
 Duration: 6 months contract 
 Client: Direct Client
 

 Rate : $40/hr on W2 
  
 Roles and responsibilities:
 

 Minimum Qualifications: 
 The candidate needs to have at least Bachelor's degree and 9 years of related IT work experience. 
 Must be able to obtain a USPS Sensitive Clearance. 
 7+ years of experience working in web application development 
 Extensive knowledge of HTML, CSS, including CSS driven layout and debugging for rapid development; experience with development and test tools such as Firebug 
 Strong Working Knowledge of JavaScript, AJAX and JavaScript frameworks (e.g., jQuery and Angular, and Require) 
 Strong understanding of cross-browser compatibility and developing for common supported browsers. (IE, Firefox, Safari) 
 Strong understanding of cross-browser compatibility and developing for common supported browsers. (IE, Firefox, Safari) 
 The candidate would need some familiarity with Oracle and PL/SQL, and object oriented concepts. 
 Strong written and verbal communications skills 
 Experience with Agile methodology and working within Agile methodology and working within Agile development teams. 
 Strong understanding of web standards, accessibility (Section 508) and usability. 
 The opportunity offers amazing potential for learning, and professional growth. Good team working skills and meticulous attention to detail is a must. 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Understanding of HTML5 concepts like use of a local data store 
 Capability to work with customers to shape and implement a strong User Experience. 
 "Production ready" user interface development experience. 
 Experience with hybrid mobile development (Cordova/PhoneGap) a plus. 
 Experience with iOS mobile development with XCode/Swift a plus.
 
 Bachelor's degree and 9 years of related IT work experience.
